question: An industrial-maintenance workflow extracts a machine identifier, retrieves two required manuals, and then synthesizes a repair plan. A high-effort capable configuration at every stage reaches 97% final accuracy but takes 18 seconds at P95 against a 12-second SLA. Stage evaluations show that a faster configuration matches identifier and lookup-selection quality, while a staged candidate using the capable configuration only for final synthesis finishes in 10.5 seconds. The faster configuration reaches only 89% on synthesis; the capable configuration reaches the required 96%. A plan must not be issued if either lookup fails. Which configuration is strongest?

options.A: Use the capable high-effort configuration sequentially at every stage because final accuracy is the only meaningful requirement.
options.B: Use the faster configuration for the entire workflow because it satisfies the extraction and lookup-selection evaluations.
options.C: Use the faster configuration for identifier and lookup planning, use the capable configuration for final synthesis only after both lookups succeed, and evaluate stage, failure, and end-to-end metrics.
options.D: Start final synthesis as soon as the first manual returns and append the second lookup later if it becomes available.

explanation: Bằng chứng ủng hộ cấu hình riêng theo từng stage. Cấu hình nhanh đủ cho trích mã và lập kế hoạch lookup; cấu hình mạnh dành cho tổng hợp cuối vì chỉ nó đạt repair accuracy. Tổng hợp chỉ bắt đầu sau khi cả hai kết quả cần thiết thành công; mọi metric stage, end-to-end, lỗi dependency và P95 phải nằm trong cổng đánh giá.

question: An incident-classification service must return a short response containing every required field. To reduce P95 completion time, the team lowered `max_tokens`; latency improved, but 6% of responses now end mid-field and fail validation. Generation time, not input processing, remains the dominant latency component. What is the best next change?

options.A: Accept truncated responses when their first field is correct because P95 latency has improved.
options.B: Increase temperature so the model is more likely to finish the required fields early.
options.C: Add prompt caching to the unique incident body and leave the truncating output limit unchanged.
options.D: Remove nonessential prose from the response contract, set the output limit with measured completion headroom, validate all required fields, and remeasure latency and accuracy.

explanation: Giới hạn output cứng là cách kiểm soát độ trễ thô và dữ liệu truncation cho thấy nó thấp hơn độ dài hợp lệ. Trước hết loại văn xuôi thừa, sau đó đặt giới hạn có headroom từ phân bố phản hồi hợp lệ và giữ validation từng trường làm cổng. Phải đo lại latency lẫn accuracy.

question: A financial-analysis service has research-preview access and uses a fast-mode-supported Claude Opus model on the Claude API with an evaluated high-effort configuration and fixed prompt. Accuracy passes, but output-dominated P95 latency is 16 seconds against a 9-second peak-hours target. The organization can fund premium fast mode only for the interactive peak cohort; overnight reports may take longer. The prompt, effort, and model may not change until a separate validation cycle. Which THREE steps form the strongest release plan?

options.A: Enable fast mode for both interactive and overnight reports because using the same model removes the need for a separate premium-cost gate.
options.B: Use fast mode for the peak cohort and rely only on default SDK retries after rate limits, treating eventual success as proof that the 9-second SLA holds.
options.C: Run a controlled fast-mode comparison on the same peak workload, verifying report accuracy and measuring P95 completion rather than assuming the advertised speedup meets the SLA.
options.D: If the comparison passes, enable fast mode only for the interactive peak cohort and retain the validated standard mode for overnight reports.
options.E: Monitor accuracy, P95 completion, `usage.speed`, premium cost, and fast capacity errors; test retry versus standard-speed fallback, including its cache miss, and define rollback gates.
options.F: On any fast-mode rate limit, retry immediately at standard speed and assume the fast-mode cache remains warm and the 9-second target still holds.

explanation: Fast mode chạy Claude Opus được hỗ trợ với output nhanh hơn nhưng giá cao; nhóm vẫn phải kiểm thử workload báo cáo rủi ro và giữ accuracy là cổng cứng. Nếu đạt, chỉ dùng fast mode cho cohort tương tác giờ cao điểm để đáp ứng 9 giây, còn batch đêm dùng chuẩn. Cần theo dõi `usage.speed`, P95, chất lượng, chi phí và lỗi capacity.

question: A contract-review assistant produces correct complete analyses in 8 seconds. Users need visible progress within 1 second, but a downstream workflow may act only after the complete response passes citation and field validation. The team does not need to reduce total generation time in this iteration. Which configuration best meets the actual latency requirement?

options.A: Stream incremental output to the interface, measure TTFT and completion separately, and keep downstream actions blocked until the final response validates.
options.B: Execute downstream actions as soon as the first streamed sentence appears because streaming implies the response is complete.
options.C: Disable validation so the workflow can act before the 8-second response finishes.
options.D: Report only total completion latency because time to first visible output is not a distinct metric.

explanation: Yêu cầu là hiển thị tiến độ đầu tiên sớm hơn, không phải hoàn tất nhanh hơn. Streaming giảm cảm giác chờ và TTFT dù toàn bộ vẫn mất 8 giây. Tích hợp phải tách nội dung tạm hiển thị khỏi kết quả đã validation dùng cho hành động, đồng thời báo cả TTFT và completion latency.

question: A safety-triage team changes the model, shortens the prompt, and lowers the output limit in one release. Average latency improves, but accuracy drops on rare high-risk cases. The prior system had no recorded TTFT or slice-specific baseline, so the team cannot attribute the regression. What is the best recovery plan?

options.A: Keep the release because average latency improved and rare cases contribute little to the aggregate score.
options.B: Restore the known accurate configuration, establish TTFT, completion, overall, and high-risk-slice baselines, then change and evaluate one latency lever at a time.
options.C: Increase the output limit while retaining the new model and prompt, then assume any recovered accuracy came from the limit.
options.D: Optimize latency further before defining quality criteria so the team can discover the fastest possible configuration.

explanation: Nhiều thay đổi cùng lúc và thiếu baseline khiến không thể quy nguyên nhân suy giảm. Cần quay lại cấu hình từng đạt chất lượng, xác định accuracy tổng thể và lát cắt quan trọng cùng TTFT, completion, rồi thử từng đòn bẩy latency trên dữ liệu đại diện. Cách này bảo vệ yêu cầu rủi ro cao và tạo bằng chứng cho từng đánh đổi.

question: A parcel-claims assistant calls Claude, an inventory service, and a refund service. The Claude API dashboard shows 99.7% successful responses, yet 8% of customers report that claims never complete. Each component has separate logs, and the team cannot tell whether a failure occurred during generation, inventory lookup, refund execution, or UI delivery. Which observability change best addresses the gap?

options.A: Alert only when the Claude API's organization-wide HTTP error rate exceeds 1%, because provider success represents workflow success.
options.B: Store only the complete prompt and response for failed sessions, then have operators infer the failed component manually.
options.C: Propagate an application trace ID through every stage; record the Claude request-id, attempt, tool-stage result, terminal workflow state, and customer-visible completion against that trace.
options.D: Map every inventory or refund failure to an Anthropic overloaded_error so all failures share one dashboard category.

explanation: Tính khả dụng nhà cung cấp chỉ là một lớp. Một application trace chung phải nối request-id Claude, số lần thử, kết quả từng stage tool và kết quả khách hàng thực thấy. Nhờ vậy phân biệt lỗi Claude API với lỗi tool hoặc giao hàng và không coi HTTP success là hoàn tất nghiệp vụ.

question: A batch document pipeline shows a ten-minute spike in cache-creation and output tokens in the organization Usage report, although the number of submitted jobs is unchanged. A job can retry one page or repeat the synthesis stage, but current logs store only the job ID and final success. Which monitoring change best distinguishes cache misses, duplicate attempts, and longer outputs?

options.A: Divide the organization token total by the number of successful jobs and attribute the same average to every page and stage.
options.B: Record only the final job latency, because a successful terminal state proves that no intermediate stage was retried.
options.C: Query the Cost API for a request-level list containing each page, stage, cache event, and retry reason.
options.D: For every Claude attempt, record root job, page, stage, prompt version, retry reason, outcome, and response usage fields for uncached input, cache creation, cache reads, and output; aggregate by minute and reconcile with the Usage report's key, workspace, and model buckets.

explanation: Usage API có token theo thời gian và chiều tổ chức nhưng không biết page, stage hay chuỗi retry của ứng dụng. Usage từng lần gọi phải nối với root job, stage, prompt version và lý do retry để phân biệt call lặp, cache và output dài. Đối chiếu tổng này với bucket Usage tương ứng giúp phát hiện telemetry thiếu hoặc đếm đôi.

question: A support platform receives 429 responses during short campaign bursts even though its hourly average request rate is below the published limit. A recent prompt-cache change may also have shifted token consumption. Which THREE monitoring and response measures best diagnose and contain the issue?

options.A: Capture RPM, ITPM, and OTPM headroom together with the remaining, reset, and retry-after response headers by model.
options.B: Use only the monthly spend total, because remaining budget determines whether a short burst receives a 429.
options.C: Track uncached input, cache creation, cache reads, output tokens, and cache rate by model and workload.
options.D: Immediately retry every 429 in parallel so the next replenishment window is fully utilized.
options.E: Infer capacity solely from hourly average RPM and omit shorter time windows.
options.F: Graph short-window peaks, pace traffic and ramp-ups, and use bounded backoff that honors retry-after while measuring retry volume.

explanation: Trung bình có thể che việc chạm giới hạn trong cửa sổ ngắn. Cần headroom cho cả ba chiều rate limit của Messages API, header phản hồi giới hạn và token field có cache để biết request, uncached input, cache creation hay output đang nghẽn. Biểu đồ cửa sổ ngắn và pacing giới hạn tuân `retry-after` tránh retry storm.
